title: Maintainer verdicts
description: Output contract for the maintainer's triage job. Exactly one verdict per input finding.

severity.description: The maintainer's severity, which may differ from the reviewer's. Derived from the matched policy rule's level.

decision_rule.description: Which decision rule from TASK_LOOP.md fired. First match wins.

policy_rule.description: Rule id from REVIEW_POLICY.md when decision_rule is policy-rule, e.g. R-011

reason.description: One or two sentences, at least 10 characters. Must reference the gate result or policy rule that decided it. A one-word reason is rejected and the whole run fails.
